text:
zhen: opened a tiny PR to add a compact 'envelope vs direct' example for function/tool calls + a short parsing fallback for nullable arrays. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5233

mira: great — can you show the envelope with a small `meta` object and a direct bare-call example side-by-side? customers keep asking which to use.

owen: also please include a 1-line normalizer for lists that might be null or a single object. we've seen this frequently in the wild.

zhen: draft examples in the PR: bare call:
```json
{"name":"get_sessions","arguments":{"user_id":"u_17"}}
```
envelope (preferred when adding provenance/confidence):
```json
{"call":{"name":"get_sessions","arguments":{"user_id":"u_17"}},"meta":{"svc":"session-svc","confidence":0.78}}
```
mira: perfect. add a 1-line note to prefer `meta` (short) instead of `metadata` to keep token overhead small. also add a one-line guardrail: "tolerate unknown fields for forward compatibility" and show "additionalProperties": true in the schema fragment.

owen: my nullable-array shim suggestion (1 line):
```js
const sessions = Array.isArray(resp.sessions) ? resp.sessions : (resp.sessions ? [resp.sessions] : []);
```
this normalizes null -> [] and single-object -> [obj].

build-bot: PR #5233 CI started — lint=running, md-link-check=running, examples-tests=queued.

zhen: adding a tiny SDK helper (6 lines) to the PR that demonstrates parse + deterministic error message for the negative path so examples-tests can assert on it. I'll make the error text exact.

mira: keep the helper short and include the exact thrown text like: `ParseError: missing required field 'user_id'` so tests are stable.

zhen: added helper snippet:
```js
try {
  return parseStructured(resp, schema);
} catch (e) {
  throw new Error("ParseError: missing required field 'user_id'");
}
```
owen: tiny nit: mention runtime key for schema metadata. eng-runtime uses `structured_output_schema` today; we plan a rename later. add a runtime note linking the issue so customers searching both keys can find it.

eng-runtime: confirmed — current key: `structured_output_schema`. planned rename tracked in runtime#782. docs should reference the current key and mention the planned rename.

build-bot: CI results for PR #5233 — lint=pass, md-link-check=pass, examples-tests=pass.

mira: quick copyedit pass done, one small grammar nit and a clarifying sentence about when to prefer envelopes vs bare calls. LGTM after that.

zhen: fixed the grammar nit and clarified: "Use envelopes when you need provenance, confidence, or routing hints; use bare calls for simple commands to reduce tokens." Pushed.

mira: approved. merging once CI finishes the site build. :rocket:

zhen: thanks all — this should cut down a few support threads about parse errors. :slightly_smiling_face:
